uslaw-usc-t2-s179u:
Section 179u of Title 2 of the United States Code, in the chapter on the Library of Congress, defines terms used in the film preservation sections. Those sections run from section 179l to section 179w. Librarian means the Librarian of Congress, and Board means the National Film Preservation Board. Film means a motion picture as defined in the copyright title.

One limit is built into the film definition. A work not first fixed on film stock, such as one fixed on videotape or laser disk, is not a film here. Publication takes its meaning from the copyright title as well. Registry version means the version of a film first published. Where original material is irretrievably lost, it means as complete a version as honest preservation work can compile.
